name: Hindi

audience.size: 528 million first-language speakers (Census 2011, includes many dialects grouped under Hindi)
audience.size_source: Census of India 2011, Language Paper 1 of 2018 (first-language speakers); verify exact figures before publishing claims
audience.demographics_note: No reliable free per-language YouTube demographics; use channel analytics (country, traffic source) once videos exist.

ramayana_traditions: Tulsidas' Ramcharitmanas (Awadhi, 16th c.) shapes popular memory in the Hindi belt
TV Ramayan (Ramanand Sagar, 1987) strongly shapes visual expectations
localization_guidance: Write originally in conversational standard Hindi; Sanskrit-derived words where natural (श्रीराम, आश्रम, करुणा), no Hinglish.
Respect forms: श्रीराम, ब्रह्मा जी, verbs in honorific plural for sages.
Flag popular elements absent from Valmiki (e.g. Lakshman Rekha, Shabari tasting berries) — do not present them as Valmiki.
Every script is written originally for this audience, never translated sentence by sentence.
Sanskrit verses stay in Sanskrit (in this script), followed by a natural explanation.

publishing.basis: Hypotheses only, to be ranked by channel 48h data via pipeline.schedule; check YouTube Studio 'When your viewers are on YouTube'.
